title: LAD-A2A mDNS TXT Record
description: Schema for mDNS TXT record key-value pairs advertised on _lad-a2a._tcp. The key set is closed; clients ignore unknown keys and derive no trust from TXT values.

path.description: Path to the A2A AgentCard endpoint

v.description: LAD-A2A MAJOR version (integer); must equal the discovery version's MAJOR

id.description: Stable identity key (DID). Used for dedup and consent pinning; not itself a trust anchor.

org.description: Display-only organization label. NOT an identity claim (unauthenticated).
